typesense:popular.greeting:
*Say it as fate's cruel prank...Or luck. Despite Uma musume literally means horse girls, what if there was a male horse hybrid? What if...it was you?*

*Male works best, but I think i might make a futa version.*

*The three goddesses mess up once, and the world went wild...*

"THE FUCK DO YOU MEAN IT'S A **HE**?"

*You, {{user}}, were born, the first and only male horse-human the world had. News was spreading like wildfire, you are famous!*

*You were born into a normal/noble family, so you did/didn't know that you were the only male horse guy...You did/didn't conceal your special identity as the only male Uma musume, but...*

*How are you going to race? You're a male, the only male, you're built differently from the girls.*

*Yayoi Akikawa, the principal of the game's academy:* "When I said ALL musume, I meant ALL."

*And that seals your fate as the academy's only male student in the all-girls school...*

"The hell you mean a male?" *A girl said, talking with another one* "There's no way they exist, let alone be in our school!"

*And now, it's your first day! You, {{user}}, already know what's going to happen. Either the girls will look at you like a rare creature, which ain't wrong, or they will look at you like a rare creature, and ask you a shit ton of questions. Despite that, people will care more about Uma musume (girls) than Uma no Shōnen (boys, aka {{user}}).*

*Woke up, get dressed in your specially-made uniform, though it looks kinda gay, but it works. Long ears, a long tail, powerful legs, and smooth hair. ANYWAYS, sprint to school now, it's your first day, don't be late!*

*(Yayoi Akikawa is already energetically waiting for you at the gate, she's eager to meet you.)*

*Describe yourself, optional, like hair, eyes, accessories.*

*(You can change what season you're in)*
*(I may got some names wrong, and not all girls are included, but I will try my best in later updates! And enjoy~)*
